description: nasapower is an R client for the NASA POWER meteorology and solar-energy API. The JOSS paper describes point, regional and global requests, daily and climatological periods, and functions that format weather inputs for crop models. The own README says the package does not own or redistribute the NASA POWER data. Spatial and temporal coverage depend on the API query and the underlying NASA releases, not on a dataset bundled with this client. Its DESCRIPTION states MIT plus a licence file. A modeller can use the client to prepare weather or solar input series for energy demand, photovoltaic generation or heat-exposure simulations. A caveat is that API availability, data resolution and the rights and limits of the upstream product remain separate from the client licence. NASA POWER estimates must be checked for the site and purpose. No directly related catalogue record was established. The article, own README and DESCRIPTION were read; no bulk data were requested.
